mapper.select: SELECT C.CAR_ID AS C_CAR_ID , C.MODEL_ID AS C_MODEL_ID , C.ADMIN_NO AS C_ADMIN_NO , C.CAR_YEAR AS C_CAR_YEAR , C.CAR_MILEAGE AS C_CAR_MILEAGE , C.CAR_PRICE AS C_CAR_PRICE , C.CAR_DESCRIPTION AS C_CAR_DESCRIPTION , C.CAR_STATUS AS C_CAR_STATUS , C.CAR_CREATED_AT AS C_CAR_CREATED_AT , CI.CAR_IMAGE_ID AS CI_CAR_IMAGE_ID , CI.CAR_ID AS CI_CAR_ID , CI.IS_PRIMARY AS CI_IS_PRIMARY , CM.MODEL_ID AS CM_MODEL_ID , CM.MODEL_NAME AS CM_MODEL_NAME , CM.BRAND_ID AS CM_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_ID AS CB_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_NAME AS CB_BRAND_NAME FROM CARS C LEFT JOIN CAR_IMAGES CI ON C.CAR_ID = CI.CAR_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_MODELS CM ON C.MODEL_ID = CM.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_BRANDS CB ON CM.BRAND_ID = CB.BRAND_ID ORDER BY C.CAR_ID, CASE WHEN CI.IS_PRIMARY = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CI.CAR_IMAGE_ID

SELECT C.CAR_ID AS C_CAR_ID , C.MODEL_ID AS C_MODEL_ID , C.ADMIN_NO AS C_ADMIN_NO , C.CAR_YEAR AS C_CAR_YEAR , C.CAR_MILEAGE AS C_CAR_MILEAGE , C.CAR_PRICE AS C_CAR_PRICE , C.CAR_DESCRIPTION AS C_CAR_DESCRIPTION , C.CAR_STATUS AS C_CAR_STATUS , C.CAR_CREATED_AT AS C_CAR_CREATED_AT , C.CAR_CONDITION AS C_CAR_CONDITION , CI.CAR_IMAGE_ID AS CI_CAR_IMAGE_ID , CI.CAR_ID AS CI_CAR_ID , CI.IS_PRIMARY AS CI_IS_PRIMARY , CM.MODEL_ID AS CM_MODEL_ID , CM.MODEL_NAME AS CM_MODEL_NAME , CM.BRAND_ID AS CM_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_ID AS CB_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_NAME AS CB_BRAND_NAME FROM CARS C LEFT JOIN CAR_IMAGES CI ON C.CAR_ID = CI.CAR_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_MODELS CM ON C.MODEL_ID = CM.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_BRANDS CB ON CM.BRAND_ID = CB.BRAND_ID WHERE C.CAR_ID = #{carId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN CI.IS_PRIMARY = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CI.CAR_IMAGE_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CAR_COUNT FROM CARS

SELECT 'car' || LPAD( NVL( MAX( TO_NUMBER( REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAR_ID, '[0-9]+$') ) ), 0 ) + 1, 3, '0' ) FROM ADMIN.CARS WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(CAR_ID, '^car[0-9]+$')
INSERT INTO ADMIN.CARS ( CAR_ID, MODEL_ID, ADMIN_NO, CAR_YEAR, CAR_MILEAGE, CAR_PRICE, CAR_DESCRIPTION, CAR_STATUS, CAR_CREATED_AT, CAR_CONDITION ) VALUES ( #{carId}, #{modelId}, #{adminNo}, #{carYear}, #{carMileage}, #{carPrice}, #{carDescription}, 0, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{carCondition} )
